name: Earl Bush
why: His senior studio portrait, identified from its own printed entry, which names the A.S. Rules and Elections seat. Recorded doubt for the editor: his brother Eddie Bush sits in the next cell, and the man captioned third in the back row of the p. 68 committee group has noticeably darker, thicker hair than either portrait. The first and second men in that back row, Bowman and McClain, both match their portraits, so the group order is sound and the discrepancy is unexplained. The portrait is published because its own caption names the office; a later pass may want to look again.
